name: the xanathar
lore:
Deep beneath Waterdeep’s bustle lies a pocket of Far Realm madness: the Xanathar. This beholder is a marvel of calcified paranoia, its orb-like form draped in silks and suspicion. Ecologically, it is an aberration that dreams reality into being; behaviorally, it is a tyrant of erratic brilliance.

While most beholders dwell in solitary xenophobia, the Xanathar has perverted its natural isolationism into a sprawling criminal syndicate. It sits at the center of a web of spies, its ten eyestalks twitching at imagined betrayals. It is a creature of jarring contrasts—capable of orchestrating city-wide conspiracies while doting with terrifying affection upon its pet goldfish, Sylgar. 

To encounter the Xanathar is to stand before a mind that perceives every shadow as a blade. Tread lightly, for in its gaze, you are either a disposable pawn or a smudge to be disintegrated.
